desc:
🐴 Welcome to Race Horses! 🏁

Build your stable, hatch your own horses, and race them for cash!
An idle RNG racing game where your stable keeps earning even offline!

How to Play:
🥚 Buy eggs and hatch your own horses
🏇 A new race every minute
🏆 All horses have a random chance of winning but better horses earn more!
🎨 Coats, eye size and traits are all random — no two horses match
✨ Hunt ultra-rare 1-in-[X] traits and shiny variants
🥰 Care for your horses for extra XP bonus
🏠 Upgrade your stable to earn faster 

Remember, your horses keep earning while you're offline ⭐

🎮 Supports Desktop, Console, Mobile, and Tablet players
